name_input: M/S. ALFA LAVAL (INDIA) LTD.; ALFA LAVAL INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; ALFA LAVAL INDIA PRIVATE LTD; ALFA LAVAL (INDIA) LTD; ALFA LAVAL (I) LTD; ALPHA LEVEL INDIA LTD.; ALFA LAVAL INDIA LTD; ALFA LAVAL (INDIA) LIMITED
export_evidence: No export bill of lading found. The only customs page retrieved (importkey.com/countries/india/alfa-laval-india-private-limited) is an IMPORT dataset: "Total Shipments 67753 Records detected" and every visible row has India as DESTINATION, e.g. "2026-02-28 | ALFA LAVAL INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | ALFA LAVAL TECHNOLOGIES AB | PARTS OF CENTRIFUGES: BOWL HOOD FOR P605 (ITEM CODE: 543566-01)- SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | STOCKHOLM ARLANDA, SWEDEN | 84219100 | 1119810". Rows actually seen: 5 of 67,753 (counter 67,753 vs 5 rows displayed); all 5 are inbound imports, 0 outbound. Slug variants tried: alfa-laval-india-private-limited (data), alfa-laval-india-limited (empty shell, no records), alfa-laval-india-pvt-ltd (empty shell, no records). volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403; web_search was unavailable (connection refused), so no second source could be checked.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India sales split was retrieved. The ImportKey page lists Alfa Laval India as a BUYER from Indian suppliers (e.g. "ALFA LAVAL KOLDING A/S. | ALFA LAVAL INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, PRADEEP METALS LIMITED, SIDDHI CNC PRIVATE LIMITED, SHREE GANESH ENGINEERING WORKS, SUPER ENGINEERS"), which indicates inbound sourcing relationships, not domestic sales. No domestic supply record with date and value was seen.
note: Legal entity ALFA LAVAL INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED exists and is active in customs data (latest record 2026-02-28), so no rejection ground applies. IMPORTANT: the declared HS codes 842191 and 848230 are confirmed as the company's actual trade codes, but only on the IMPORT side — 84219100 appears verbatim in the import rows ("PARTS OF CENTRIFUGES: BOWL HOOD FOR P605", HS 84219100, B/L 1119810, 2026-02-28, from Stockholm/Sweden). No export shipment with date, destination and B/L number was found, so export_status is none_found rather than confirmed. The claimed industry "IT и электроника" does not match the observed trade: the goods are centrifuge parts, tubes/pipes/fittings and heat-exchanger/separator components (HS 842191, 730729) — i.e. process equipment, not IT/electronics. Domestic supply evidence: следов поставок на внутренний рынок не найдено в доступных источниках (GST/GeM not public in retrieved pages). Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the sources read; not estimated. Note the name list mixes several spellings including "ALPHA LEVEL INDIA LTD.", which is a different transliteration and was not separately verified.
